newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees small short term o/n fall.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy mkt sees small short term o/n fall.

text.p: Italy's money market sees the overnight rate easing slightly near term but falling below the current 6.75 percent discount rate medium term, a study based on implicit rates by Bocconi University research arm Igier showed.
The market sees the implicit overnight rate standing at 6.79 percent in a month's time compared with 6.89 percent at market close on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study.
One week ago the implicit overnight rate on the same time horizon was seen at 6.86 percent, while one month ago it was forecast at 6.78 percent.
On a three month timeframe the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.62 percent from 6.74 percent forecast last week and 6.57 percent one month ago.
On a one year horizon, the implicit overnight rate is seen dropping to 6.23 percent from 6.47 percent seen a week ago and 6.35 percent one month ago.
On a two year timeframe, the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.28 percent from 6.54 percent forecast a week ago and 6.80 percent one month ago.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate and the implicit German overnight rate on a two year horizon is considered a good indicator of market confidence in Italy joining Europe's economic and monetary union.
This week that spread fell to 172 basis points from 201 last week and 203 one month ago.
